adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Painful oral erosions plus flaccid Nikolsky-positive bullae are pemphigus vulgaris. IgG against desmogleins disrupts desmosomal keratinocyte adhesion and causes intraepidermal acantholysis.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Bullous pemphigoid can produce blisters but targets hemidesmosomal proteins and usually tense bullae without prominent mucosal erosions. Desmosomes/desmogleins uniquely match pemphigus vulgaris.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Independent reread found no authoritative basis to reverse the key and no alternative option remains defensible at the requested granularity.

correction_history.prior_source_defect: Initial supporting source was Pemphigus Vegetans despite correct shared desmoglein mechanism.
correction_history.repair: Replaced with direct Pemphigus Vulgaris StatPearls source NBK560860.
